activation.title: Activate device account
activation.description: Scan a one-time HBDEV1 activation code created by an admin, or enter the full code manually. You'll see the binding details to confirm before the code is used.
activation.cameraPermission: Allow camera access to scan the QR code, or enter the code below.
activation.storeCount_one: The account currently has access to {{count}} store
activation.storeCount_other: The account currently has access to {{count}} stores

activation.sessionFailed: The binding was saved, but the account session couldn't be loaded. Go back and try logging in with the bound account.

activation.recoveryFailed: The previous binding result could not be confirmed. Preview the code again.
activation.deviceAccountDescription: Log in with the bound account's current permissions and all its stores, without entering its password.

keychainReset.title: Saved login data
keychainReset.description: If login keeps failing, even with other accounts, you can clear the login details saved on this phone. Your account on the server and the device binding aren't affected.
keychainReset.confirmMessage: This clears the login details saved on this phone. You'll need to log in again with your username and password.
keychainReset.ok: Cleared. Secure storage on this phone works normally. Go back and log in again.
keychainReset.residual: Cleared, but secure storage still holds leftovers ({{items}}). Fully close the app and try again.
keychainReset.probeFailed: Cleared, but reading or writing the phone's secure storage (Keychain) failed: {{message}}. Restart the phone and try again.
